name: PixelLoop
description: Decorative constellation loop with rounded-dot and 45-degree vector-stroke variants.

ariaRequirements: The decorative container and all six glyphs are hidden from assistive technology.
The component never enters the tab order.

governance.note: The Primary Studio reference informed the compact modular format, while original 5x5 bitmap artwork, round marks, row-aware choreography, and timing establish a distinct implementation. Supports one, two, or three rows of three glyph grids. Alpha while forced-colors and light/dark verification remain pending outside the supplied Storybook contexts.
